department: Department of Information Technology and Electrical Engineering (D-ITET)

deadline.value: No deadline: professors recruit doctoral students throughout the year, so apply whenever a position is open. Bachelor's holders applying for the Direct Doctorate must apply in the Master's window, 1-30 November 2026.
deadline.quote: There are no deadlines for submitting the registration for the doctorate, as the professors recruit their candidates throughout the year.

also.quote: International Bachelor's degrees: 1 - 30 November 2026 | students who wish to apply for the Excellence & Opportunity Scholarship Programme (ESOP) or a Direct doctorate programme (DD)

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Send your application for a PhD position directly to individual professors; you are supervised individually by a professor.
supervisor.quote: Applications for a PhD position should be sent directly to the individual professors.

funding.value: D-ITET doctoral students generally hold paid positions in the department's research labs.
funding.quote: Doctoral students at D-ITET generally hold paid positions with one of the research laboratories of the department.

entry_route.value: A Master's from a well-reputed university is normally required; outstanding Bachelor's graduates can apply for the Direct Doctorate (MSc EEIT + doctorate), which needs a future supervisor's funding confirmation.
entry_route.quote: Applicants must have a master degree from a well reputed university.

also.quote: Students with outstanding performances during their bachelor's studies can seek direct admission to doctoral studies within the direct doctorate programme at D-ITET. | For a successful application, a confirmation of the future supervisor is needed, applications without it, will not be considered.

notes: Admission may be conditional on passing one or two ETH courses. The Direct Doctorate goes through the MSc EEIT application, which requires the GRE General for Bachelor's degrees from outside the EU/EFTA.
